summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 46 on Artificial Intelligence and 17 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Lessons from the Underground: How to Combat Business Email Compromise
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, scams
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 43 articles published in the last 24 hours
